intro.title: Hi, I’m Wurizip!
intro.description: Your Opustown companion. Curious about what makes a project valuable? Let’s take a closer look together.

topics.title: What are you curious about?
topics.description: Pick a topic and I’ll share a few helpful things to look for.

declined.title: I’ll be right here.
declined.description: Enjoy exploring! Tap “Ask Wurizip” whenever you would like a little guidance.

options.label: What gives a project value?
options.title: Look beyond the first impression.
options.description: A great project tells a clear story. Here are three things worth checking:
tips: Look for original work and a clear creative direction.
Review the scope, deliverables, and usage rights.
Compare the asking price with similar projects.

options.label: Tell me about the creator
options.title: Get to know the person behind it.
options.description: The creator is part of the story. A little research can help you feel more confident.
tips: Explore their portfolio and previous projects.
Read available reviews and community feedback.
Ask about their process, availability, and experience.

options.label: What should I check first?
options.title: The details make the difference.
options.description: Before taking the next step, give these project essentials a quick look.
tips: Read the full project description and included files.
Check timelines, revisions, and licensing terms.
Contact the creator about anything that is unclear.

footer.intro: A little guidance goes a long way.
